content.text:
The Growth team signs off on it. Since 2026-09-01 the notifier has belonged to Growth. Post the change in **#growth-eng**, and any Growth engineer can approve template and copy changes.

You may see an older note saying Dana Okafor has to sign off. That's out of date: Dana moved to Platform, and that note has already been marked as replaced by the current one. This comes from the team's shared notes; the repo has no CODEOWNERS file to confirm it.

When you edit the wording, change both versions of the email in `services/notifier/templates/`: the `<event>.mjml` file and its plain-text `<event>.txt` twin. The two need to stay in sync, because some corporate mail gateways strip HTML. Template variables should stay snake_case.
